contract.quantity: signed radial displacement over [0, 100 ns]; inward is negative
contract.allowed_information: Only public observation and question; no truth, condition, or generator seed.
contract.label_rule: Unbounded nuisance => ambiguous. Otherwise Gaussian 95% interval enlarged by the supplied nuisance bound; upper <= -resolution => compression_supported; lower > -resolution => compression_not_supported; else ambiguous.
contract.mismatch_rule: Contract decision uses advertised information even under undetectable mismatch; physical false confidence is scored separately.
contract.acceptance_status: provisional engineering gates; no facility decision requirement available
contract.interpretation: No weighted score. Confidence sets conditional on supplied noise/bounds. No melting, mechanism, raw-PDV, liner-transfer, or real-data validation claim.
